      Reckitt.com Homepage

      We are Reckitt, a world-class consumer health and hygiene company. Founded in 1840, in Hull, United Kingdom, we are home to some of the world's most trusted brands.

      We exist to deliver better health in more hands, every day.

      Our footprint spans more than 80 countries. Every day, millions of people around the world rely on Reckitt brands to care for themselves, the people they love and the homes they live in.

      Through trusted brands, science-led innovation and deep consumer understanding, we're helping to strengthen communities by making better health and hygiene more accessible, every day.
